silhouette.reason: ISO 20 ft box with corner castings, armoured side bays, door end with four cam lock bars and status strip: reads as a container at once. The top line stays straight on purpose: anything above the top castings would stop it stacking and twist-locking (the asset's engine contract), so the critique's antenna/light bar is not added.
fixes: deeper bay relief (8–10 cm) or a trapezoidal rib between bays so the long-side outline is not a flat plane at grazing angles

proportions.reason: Frame 6.058 × 2.438 × 2.591 m on ISO 668; castings 178 × 162 × 118 mm and 2 259 mm centres pass the measures; doors fill the opening between the posts.

materials.reason: Painted steel shell and frame (teal and off-white as paint colour, chipped to steel at the strip's chips), cast-iron corner castings, galvanised lock bars, hinges and bolts that read as metal, rubber pockets; glow on the strip and keypad. UVs now box-projected per triangle at true scale (the stretched streaks on posts are gone). Paint roughness is uniform.
fixes: roughness variation where hands touch (door handles, keypad)
darker emissive housing behind the status strip

detail.reason: Bays with seams, vents, bolts, stencilled owner code on side and door, hazard bands, cam keepers and handles, hinge knuckles and pins, forklift pockets, cargo inside. Roof is ribs over a plate; no gasket line or customs seal.
fixes: door gasket line and customs seal on the right leaf
forklift pockets as real recesses with a lip

wear.reason: weather() (measured, in the manifest): chipped convex edges 15 %, rust streaking down from side edges 8 %, two to four dents in the side bays, bleached roof, dust on top, dirt at the sill; plus rust decals under vents and bolts and the strip's paint chips. It looks like it has crossed oceans. Doors are not weathered yet.
fixes: run the door leaves through weather() too (hinge-space, separate call)

lod.reason: LOD2 (736) keeps the orange band, the four lock bars and the status strip, and the bay grid as flush quads; colours match LOD0. The roof reads lighter at LOD2 without its ribs.
fixes: keep the roof ribs as quads at LOD2 so the roof value matches

technical.reason: QA PASS incl. the weather gate; 23 022 / 8 342 / 736, one material, glow + light socket, doorArc check. LOD0 is now heavy for a prop: weather() refinement at 0.6 m splits every long bevel. Now 22 914 / 8 342 / 736. Connections gate clean (was 9 findings): rust streaks start at the panel bolts on the bay panel face, 2 mm into it, and end on that panel (they used to hover 1.5–5 cm off the plates and over the recesses).
fixes: weather only the side/roof plates (not the bevelled frame) to halve the refinement cost
split only faces taller than one strip band in the UV pass
